sources.entry: Budget Board - Simple app for tracking monthly spending and working towards financial goals. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Budget Board is a self-hosted personal finance app for tracking monthly spending and working toward financial goals, positioned as an alternative to the shut-down Mint app.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you manage financial accounts (checking, savings, credit cards) and assets (property, valuables) in one place. You can record and categorize transactions and set monthly budgets per category to track spending against them. It supports bulk transaction import from CSV files and syncing with financial institutions through the SimpleFIN and LunchFlow providers. It can auto-categorize transactions with a machine learning model trained on your categorized data, and apply user-defined rules that update transactions by description, amount, or date. Users can set financial goals such as saving for a house or paying off debt, and view customizable trend charts filtered by date range, account, and category. Login is local with two-factor authentication or via an OIDC provider, and the interface is available in English, German, French, and Simplified Chinese.
use_cases: set category budgets and compare against actual spending
import bank transactions from CSV files
sync bank accounts automatically via SimpleFIN or LunchFlow
set and track savings or debt payoff goals
how_to_run: Check the project wiki for setup instructions
notable: Auto-categorization using a machine learning model trained on your own categorized transactions
Syncs with SimpleFIN and LunchFlow for automatic transaction and balance updates

Localized date and number formats across supported languages
